title: 2 TASMANIAN POTTERY VASES BY R...
reason: Two crackle and crystalline-glaze studio vases attributed to Rynne Tanton, a collected Launceston potter whose signed pieces retail around A$280 each; attribution unverified (no base shown).
findings: Two studio pottery vases in a single photo with no base shown, so no signature or maker's mark can be read and the Rynne Tanton attribution rests on the catalogue alone. Left vase: squat globular form with a flared turquoise collar and a mottled blue crystalline-type glaze over incised chevron or feather texture. Right vase: ovoid form with a flared glossy red-brown collar and a white crackle glaze over exposed brown stoneware in a cracked-earth pattern. Rynne Tanton (b. 1944, Launceston area, Tasmania) is a recognised Australian studio potter known for crackle and crystalline glazes, with a 1977 covered jar in the NGV collection; a Sydney dealer (Cache Antiques) has asked A$280 for a single signed Tanton crackle/crystalline vase (17 cm). The glaze styles here are consistent with his work, but this is unverified from the photo. Size not stated.
condition: Blue vase shows pale scratches or scuffs low on the body near the foot. Crackle vase looks intact. No obvious chips or cracks at the collars, but only one view of each and the bases are not shown.
rescore_note: Two attractive crackle and crystalline glaze studio vases that fit Rynne Tanton (Launceston potter, signed on the base per dealers) but no base is shown so the attribution is unverified; a Sydney dealer asked A$280 for one signed vase (cacheantiques.com Tanton vase page, seen 19/10/2026), so my estimate is $150 to $250 for the pair.
